scope: Typed colors from prebuilt CSS component syntax and allocation-free CPU color conversion only. No style, layout, painting, GPU, UI, JS, network, website or Chrome comparison.
method: Core Ultra 7 356H, taskset CPU 0, three sequential alternating runs per mode, 20 iterations per conversion workload, 20000 typed parse/resolution iterations. Final measured runs have no concurrent test/build launched by this session; other machine load, clocks and thermals are uncontrolled. Conversion copies reset input outside warm timed regions. First full conversion includes per-step clock samples; warm samples do not. 4096-color steps. RSS is the entire synthetic benchmark including generated vectors and allocator retention, not color-only, page or browser memory.

caveats: Scalar/optimized controls preserve semantics but code generation/layout differs; this includes compiler effects, not a pure instruction-set ablation.
f64 storage wins some conversion timings but doubles Color storage; f32 chosen for compact retained values and CSS minimum precision.
Simple typed parse uses prebuilt Syntax; CSS lexical parsing/source allocation costs are excluded.
Single-threaded in-process worker APIs add no background tasks, clocks or idle polling. Full browser idle/latency are not measured.
